title: Resource Observation Source Contract v1
description: Source registry and archived resource observations. A candidate source never creates an observation until its downloaded rows, time semantics, unit and geography are checked.

source_observations.csv.description: Normalized observations with source_record_id, observation_time and available_time.

candidate_source.description: Catalogued only; cannot enter the default resource snapshot.

imported.description: Archived rows have a source hash and pass unit/geography/time validation.

verified.description: Imported rows have passed an independent review or source cross-check.

missing_quantity.description: Missing quantity is unknown, never zero.
